metadata.title: Daniel Marcos Ferreira — Mid-level Full-Stack Developer
metadata.description: Mid-level full-stack developer in Ivrea, Torino, Italy. React, Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Node.js, NestJS, Firebase. Open to remote-first EU teams.

hero.languagesLine: Italian and Brazilian by birth · Fluent in Portuguese and English
hero.name: Daniel Marcos Ferreira
hero.profile: Mid-level full-stack developer with proven experience designing and building scalable, performant, responsive web applications. Strong frontend focus with React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS, plus robust backend work using Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, and SQL/NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase). Experienced across the full software lifecycle—from intuitive UI design to complex REST API integration—with a focus on code quality, clean code, and collaborative Agile (Scrum) delivery.

experience.title: Professional delivery at scale.
experience.lede: FIGTREE, NOVAWARE, and ORBWARE—ed-tech products, custom software at a software house, and role-based condo management.
